_note: The reward beat: the protagonist gets something they came for, and it is not free. (The Hero's Journey's Reward.)
entries: {first} took {PRIZE:!inner} at last, and {SOMEONE:human} did not try to stop it.
With {THING:portable} in hand, {first} {ACT_PLACE} {landmark} and held {PRIZE:!inner} for one night.
{first} won {WINDFALL}, and for a while {FEELING} was gone.
{first} claimed {THING:!living,!bulky}, and {CLOSE:human} saw what it had cost.
{first} got what {first} came for, and {SOMEONE:human} was the first to notice.
{first} and {CLOSE:human} shared {WINDFALL} at {landmark}, and it felt like enough.
At {landmark}, {first} {ACT_THING} {THING} {MANNER}, and {PRIZE:!inner} was close enough to touch.
{first} carried {THING:portable} out of {landmark}, and {VALUE} weighed more than it did.
